title: Healthcare Agentic DE - Clinical Ops (Gold)
description: Genie over the governed Gold tables of databricks-agentic-de (synthetic data). Patient identifiers are masked by Unity Catalog. Questions reach this space through the project's guardrail layer (agent/tools/genie.py).

question: How many patients are currently in the ICU?
What is the current census by unit?
What was the average heart rate by unit in the latest 15-minute window?
How many providers do we have per specialty?

content:
Metric definitions (shared with the project's fallback agent; use these, not your own):
* Current census = count of encounters in fct_encounters with status = 'in-progress', grouped by unit when asked per unit.
* Census at a past time T = count of distinct patient_id in fct_encounter_history where valid_from <= T and (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > T) and status = 'in-progress'. fct_encounters only holds current state.
* fct_encounter_history has one row per version of an encounter; never count its rows as encounters.
* Live vitals: gold_live_vitals_by_unit has one row per unit per 15-minute window. The newest window may still be filling; say so when reporting it. Combine windows with sum(avg_heart_rate * reading_count) / sum(reading_count), never avg(avg_heart_rate).
* Out-of-range heart rate = outside 55-140 bpm (clinical alert band, not a physical-impossibility filter).
Governance:
* full_name and mrn are masked by policy and show ***REDACTED***. Never try to reveal, infer or reconstruct them.
* Don't report a group that covers fewer than 11 patients; say it is too small to report.
* All data is synthetic (simulated), not real patients.

question: What is the current census by unit?
sql:
SELECT unit, count(*) AS current_census
FROM healthcare_agentic_de.gold.fct_encounters
WHERE status = 'in-progress'
GROUP BY unit
ORDER BY unit

question: How many patients were in the ED at a given time?
sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT patient_id) AS census
FROM healthcare_agentic_de.gold.fct_encounter_history
WHERE unit = 'ED' AND status = 'in-progress'
  AND valid_from <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-07 02:25:00'
  AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > TIMESTAMP '2026-10-07 02:25:00')

question: Average heart rate by unit across all windows
sql:
SELECT unit,
  round(sum(avg_heart_rate * reading_count) / sum(reading_count), 1) AS avg_heart_rate,
  sum(out_of_range_count) AS out_of_range_readings
FROM healthcare_agentic_de.gold.gold_live_vitals_by_unit
GROUP BY unit
ORDER BY unit
